scenes.setting: Alone after seeing Aaron out: the paper crane, luster-less yet touched by fate, is the dream's medium — instilled either through the spirit world itself or as a seed in his subconscious; a lecture-in-thought on the spirit world's timeless sea, then divination shows no danger and breakfast is finished cold
scenes.text_anchor: Therefore, Klein suspected that the medium which instilled the dream into Dr. Aaron was the paper crane!

scenes.setting: Old Kohler's crowded third-floor room: most of his pay goes on information, the rest saved against old age — talk of a Single Elder Aid Policy — and a quiet request to stop mentioning the volunteer search. 'No one will laugh at your kindness.'
scenes.text_anchor: “Most of the money is for gathering information for you.”

scenes.setting: Liv's house again: Daisy back at the iron among dripping laundry, the vocabulary book returned, two pounds passed off as a reporter's advance and pressed on them as 'a rule' — then a hasty exit and a low verdict on the street: 'There has never been a savior…'
